pacing.label: Pace
pacing.description: How quickly the video moves from shot to shot.

options.fast: Fast — quick cuts, no dead air
options.beatSynced: On the beat — cut to the music

storytelling.label: Story order
storytelling.description: How the video is told from start to finish.

options.hookFirst: Hook first — open on the best moment

editing.label: Cuts
editing.description: How one shot joins the next.

tone.label: Tone
tone.description: The feeling the video should leave.

captions.label: Captions
captions.description: How burned-in captions look, when the workflow adds them.

options.punch: One big word at a time

color.label: Colour
color.description: The colour look, when the workflow grades the footage.

music.label: Music energy
music.description: How lively the background music should be.

graphics.label: On-screen text
graphics.description: How many titles and labels appear.

dynamics.label: Dynamic effects
dynamics.description: How many punch-ins, flashes and speed changes land on the beat.

original.label: As set up
original.hint: Keep the shape the workflow is set up with.

portrait.hint: Portrait — feed posts that fill more of the screen

auto.label: Auto
auto.hint: Same as today: up to 1080p, or your plan's limit if lower

p2160.label: 4K
p2160.hint: Ultra HD, 2160p. Uses about 4x the render credits of 1080p

cap.under1080: Your plan renders up to {cap}p. Upgrade to render at 1080p or 4K.
cap.from1080: Your plan renders up to {cap}p. Upgrade to render in 4K.

form.name: Name
form.descriptionHint: Optional. A reminder of when to use this style.
form.notesHint: Optional. Anything else about the look and feel, in a sentence or two. It is treated as a preference, never as an instruction.
form.pickOne: Pick at least one choice or write a note.

picker.styleHint: How the AI should cut this video. Manage your own styles on the Styles page.

page.title: Styles
page.intro: A style tells the AI how to cut your video: how fast, in what order, how shots join, and how captions, colour, music and on-screen text should feel. Pick one when you run a workflow: the same footage can come out as a quick social reel or a calm documentary.
page.emptyTitle: No styles of your own yet
page.emptyBody: Create one from scratch, or start from a built-in style below and make it yours.
page.savedBody: "{name}" is ready to use when you run a workflow.
page.deleteBody: Delete the style “{name}”? Runs that already used it keep their own copy.
